fault: A microservice declares a dependency on a peer microservice, so both land in the same Unordered_Statement of the Build_Sequence and the Verification_Pass reports that their relative build order is not guaranteed.

partition.justification: An npm clean install over this workspace succeeds — npm installs one workspace package depending on another without objection — while the ordered repository build's Build_Sequence Verification_Pass still reports the prerequisite violation over the installed tree. The repository-wide build path (runOrderedBuildCli) derives no dependency sets, so the peer-dependency resolver is never reached and [deps:peer] does not fire; only the ordering Verification_Pass, which builds a Prerequisite_Edge between the two statement-4 microservices, reports.
